author: CBR
description:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day went through countless suit designs before the filmmakers found the right shade of blue. The goal was to recreate the classic Amazing Fantasy look, where Spider-Man’s bright blue coloring drops into deep, inky black shadows.

The suit’s red fabric was designed differently, with a softer, velvety appearance and less shine than the blue. The result gives Tom Holland’s new Spider-Man suit a classic comic-inspired look while still feeling distinct in live action.

description:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day was designed to put audiences directly in Spider-Man’s suit. Director Destin Daniel Cretton explains how the filmmakers studied parkour athletes, wingsuit flyers, skydivers, base jumpers, and their GoPro camera angles to make Spidey’s movement feel real.
